relationships.note: He gives them as one word: the April 1st start, the Passover time frame and the acceleration of signs are the same thing in a continuous passage.
He names the failure mode of date-setting accurately using 1988 and 2000, and the corpus carries a great deal of dated material of its own. The two claims sit either side of that gap.
He ties the pregnancy timing to the warning about the president being taken out, naming this as the time he warned them about.
Two claims about a deliberate squeeze on the meat supply. He does not join them in this passage.
He says outright it is not an organised event but a lone wolf, which is the same distinction he draws elsewhere between the lone wolves and the main show.
